design: V5 — bearing-supported rotor with guided full-cap press
material: PETG for rigid printed parts; purchased metal bearing and springs
return: Three purchased compression springs; switch is not the cap return spring
service: Remove the three outer-race retainer screws, lift off the cap, unscrew the inner-race nut, then remove the carrier guide screws and PCB screws
publication: Local V5 mechanical prototype; not published or physically qualified
cap_style_change: Undo three countersunk screws to transfer the common bearing assembly to another cap
magnet_installation: One diametrically magnetized diameter 5 x thickness 1.5 mm disc in each module; retain with adhesive after fit and field checks
pcb_retention: Four M2 nylon screws on solid posts; no flexible printed latches

bearing.note: Nominal purchased bearing envelope. Confirm race shoulder lands, corner radii, actual fits and magnetic influence with the chosen supplier/sample.

return_springs.note: Purchase matched springs meeting these dimensions/force requirements; actual force and return must be measured.

actuator.material: Silicone elastomer; shape-reference STL is not a rigid print part
actuator.qualification: Select material and shims from measured assembled switch travel and force; maximum switch load and ring compression remain unqualified.
